text_en: When King Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,
text_cn: 当耶路撒冷王阿多尼责德克听说若苏厄攻占了哈依，完全予以毁灭，对待哈依和哈依王如对待耶里哥和耶里哥王一样；又听说基贝红居民已与以色列媾(gòu)和，可住在他们中间，

text_en: he became greatly frightened, because Gibeon was a large city, like one of the royal cities, and was larger than Ai, and all its men were warriors.
text_cn: 大为震惊，因为基贝红是座大城，像座京城，比哈依还大，城中的人又都勇敢。

text_en: So King Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem sent a message to King Hoham of Hebron, to King Piram of Jarmuth, to King Japhia of Lachish, and to King Debir of Eglon, saying,
text_cn: 耶路撒冷王阿多尼责德克遂打发使者去见赫贝龙王曷罕、雅尔慕特王丕兰、拉基士王雅非亚和厄革隆王德彼尔说：

text_en: “Come up and help me, and let us attack Gibeon; for it has made peace with Joshua and with the Israelites. ”
text_cn: “请你们前来援助我，攻打基贝红，因为这城已与若苏厄和以色列人媾和。”

text_en: Then the five kings of the Amorites—the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon—gathered their forces, and went up with all their armies and camped against Gibeon, and made war against it.
text_cn: 那五个阿摩黎王，即耶路撒冷王、赫贝龙王、雅尔慕特王、拉基士王和厄革隆王联合起来，率领他们所有的军队上去包围了基贝红，合力进攻。

text_en: And the Gibeonites sent to Joshua at the camp in Gilgal, saying, “Do not abandon your servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us; for all the kings of the Amorites who live in the hill country are gathered against us. ”
text_cn: 基贝红人即派人到基耳加耳营中见若苏厄说：“你不要袖手不顾你的仆人，请快上来援救，扶助我们，因为住在山地的众阿摩黎王都联合起来攻击我们。”

text_en: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the fighting force with him, all the mighty warriors.
text_cn: 若苏厄遂亲率他的一切军民，和所有的精兵，从基耳加耳上去了。

text_en: The Lord said to Joshua, “Do not fear them, for I have handed them over to you; not one of them shall stand before you. ”
text_cn: 上主对若苏厄说：“你不要怕他们，因为我已将他们交在你手中，没有一人能抵抗你。”

text_en: So Joshua came upon them suddenly, having marched up all night from Gilgal.
text_cn: 若苏厄由基耳加耳出发，整夜行军，出其不意，突然向他们进攻。

text_en: And the Lord threw them into a panic before Israel, who inflicted a great slaughter on them at Gibeon, chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth-horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
text_cn: 上主使他们在以色列人前大为混乱，以色列人在基贝红将他们完全击败，随后在往贝特曷龙的上坡路上追赶他们，击杀他们直到阿则卡，直到玛刻达。

text_en: As they fled before Israel, while they were going down the slope of Beth-horon, the Lord threw down huge stones from heaven on them as far as Azekah, and they died; there were more who died because of the hailstones than the Israelites killed with the sword.
text_cn: 当他们逃避以色列人，来到贝特曷龙下坡时，上主从天上降下冰雹，落在他们身上，直落到阿则卡，死伤无数；为冰雹砸死的人，比以色列用刀杀死的还多。

text_en: On the day when the Lord gave the Amorites over to the Israelites, Joshua spoke to the Lord ; and he said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still at Gibeon, and Moon, in the valley of Aijalon. ”
text_cn: 上主将阿摩黎人交于以色列子民的那一天，若苏厄当着以色列人的面对上主说： “太阳！停在基贝红！月亮！停在阿雅隆谷！”

text_en: And the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, until the nation took vengeance on their enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Jashar? The sun stopped in midheaven, and did not hurry to set for about a whole day.
text_cn: 太阳果然停住，月亮站住不动，直到百姓报复了自己的仇敌。这事岂不是记载在“义士书”上了吗？太阳停在空中，未急速下落，约有一整天。

text_en: There has been no day like it before or since, when the Lord heeded a human voice; for the Lord fought for Israel.
text_cn: 以前或以后，从来没有一天像这天一样。上主这样俯听了人的呼声，因为是上主在为以色列人作战。

text_en: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
text_cn: 此后，若苏厄和所有跟随他的以色列人，回了基耳加耳营。

text_en: Meanwhile, these five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.
text_cn: 至于那五个逃脱的王子，藏在玛刻达山洞里，

text_en: And it was told Joshua, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah. ”
text_cn: 有人来通知若苏厄说：“那五个王子已被发现，藏在玛刻达山洞里。”

text_en: Joshua said, “Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and set men by it to guard them;
text_cn: 若苏厄吩咐说：“你们把几块大石滚到洞口，派人看守。

text_en: but do not stay there yourselves; pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Do not let them enter their towns, for the Lord your God has given them into your hand. ”
text_cn: 你们不可停下来，要去追赶敌人，切断他们的后路，不容他们逃入城中，因为上主你们的天主，已将他们交在你们手中。”

text_en: When Joshua and the Israelites had finished inflicting a very great slaughter on them, until they were wiped out, and when the survivors had entered into the fortified towns,
text_cn: 若苏厄和以色列子民杀得他们惨败，几乎将他们全部消灭，只剩下一些逃脱的人进入了坚城。

text_en: all the people returned safe to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah; no one dared to speak against any of the Israelites.
text_cn: 军民都平安无恙地回到玛刻达营见若苏厄。以后没有人再敢侮辱以色列子民。

text_en: Then Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave, and bring those five kings out to me from the cave. ”
text_cn: 那时若苏厄说：“你们去打开洞口，把那五个王子从洞里拉出，带到我这里来。”

text_en: They did so, and brought the five kings out to him from the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
text_cn: 人就去，将那五个王子，就是耶路撒冷王、赫贝龙王、雅尔慕特王、拉基士王和厄革隆王，从洞里拉出，带到他面前。

text_en: When they brought the kings out to Joshua, Joshua summoned all the Israelites, and said to the chiefs of the warriors who had gone with him, “Come near, put your feet on the necks of these kings. ” Then they came near and put their feet on their necks.
text_cn: 当人们把那些王子带到若苏厄面前时，若苏厄将所有的以色列人召来，对那些与他同去作战的军长说：“你们前来，将脚踏在这些王子的脖子上！”他们就前来，将脚踏在那些王子的脖子上。

text_en: And Joshua said to them, “Do not be afraid or dismayed; be strong and courageous; for thus the Lord will do to all the enemies against whom you fight. ”
text_cn: 若苏厄对他们说：“你们不要害怕，不要沮丧，只要勇敢果断，因为上主必要这样对待你们所征服的一切仇人。”

text_en: Afterward Joshua struck them down and put them to death, and he hung them on five trees. And they hung on the trees until evening.
text_cn: 随后，若苏厄将那五个王子杀死，将他们悬在五棵树上，直悬至晚上。

text_en: At sunset Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden themselves; they set large stones against the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.
text_cn: 到太阳快落的时候，若苏厄命人将他们由树上放下来，丢在他们藏过的山洞里，用大石头塞住洞口；那些大石至今尚在。

text_en: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it and its king with the edge of the sword; he utterly destroyed every person in it; he left no one remaining. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
text_cn: 若苏厄当天就占领了玛刻达，并用利剑击杀了那城和城中的王子，并将城中的一切生灵完全毁灭，一个也没有留下；他对待玛刻达王如对待耶里哥王一样。

text_en: Then Joshua passed on from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.
text_cn: 若苏厄和跟随他的众以色列人，由玛刻达往里贝纳推进，攻打里贝纳。

text_en: The Lord gave it also and its king into the hand of Israel; and he struck it with the edge of the sword, and every person in it; he left no one remaining in it; and he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
text_cn: 上主也将这城和城中的王子交在以色列人手中；他们用利剑击杀了城和城中的一切生灵，一个也没有留下；他对待这城的王子如对待耶里哥王一样。

text_en: Next Joshua passed on from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and laid siege to it, and assaulted it.
text_cn: 若苏厄和跟随他的众以色列人，又从里贝纳往拉基士推进，围攻拉基士，

text_en: The Lord gave Lachish into the hand of Israel, and he took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and every person in it, as he had done to Libnah.
text_cn: 上主将拉基士也交在以色列人手中。第二天若苏厄就攻取了拉基士，用利剑击杀了那城和城中的一切生灵，全如对待里贝纳一样。

text_en: Then King Horam of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, leaving him no survivors.
text_cn: 那时，革则尔王曷兰上来援救拉基士，若苏厄也将他和他的人民杀尽，一个也没有留下。

text_en: From Lachish Joshua passed on with all Israel to Eglon; and they laid siege to it, and assaulted it;
text_cn: 此后，若苏厄和跟随他的众以色列人，由拉基士往厄革隆推进，围攻厄革隆。

text_en: and they took it that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword; and every person in it he utterly destroyed that day, as he had done to Lachish.
text_cn: 当天就攻下了那城，并在那天用利剑杀尽了那城和城中的一切生灵，全如对待拉基士一样。

text_en: Then Joshua went up with all Israel from Eglon to Hebron; they assaulted it,
text_cn: 此后，若苏厄和跟随他的众以色列人，从厄革隆上到赫贝龙，攻打那城；

text_en: and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and its king and its towns, and every person in it; he left no one remaining, just as he had done to Eglon, and utterly destroyed it with every person in it.
text_cn: 占领后，用利剑击杀了那城和城中的王子，以及属于他的一切城邑和城邑中的一切生灵，一个也没有留下；将那城和城中的一切生灵完全消灭，全如对待厄革隆一样。

text_en: Then Joshua, with all Israel, turned back to Debir and assaulted it,
text_cn: 此后，若苏厄和跟随他的众以色列人，转身向德彼尔推进，攻打那城；

text_en: and he took it with its king and all its towns; they struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed every person in it; he left no one remaining; just as he had done to Hebron, and, as he had done to Libnah and its king, so he did to Debir and its king.
text_cn: 获得了那城和那城的王子，以及属德彼尔的一切城邑后，用利剑击杀了他们，将这些城内的一切生灵完全毁灭，一个也没有留下；对待德彼尔城和城中的王子，有如对待赫贝龙和赫贝龙的王子一样，又如对待里贝纳和里贝纳王子一样。

text_en: So Joshua defeated the whole land, the hill country and the Negeb and the lowland and the slopes, and all their kings; he left no one remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.
text_cn: 若苏厄征服了那一带地方，包括山地、乃革布、平原、山坡和那些地方的王子；并照上主以色列的天主的命令，消灭了所有的生灵，一个也没有留下，

text_en: And Joshua defeated them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, as far as Gibeon.
text_cn: 由卡德士巴尔乃亚起，直到迦萨，以及哥笙全境，直到基贝红。

text_en: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.
text_cn: 若苏厄这次出征，能获取所有的王子和他们的土地，是因为上主以色列的天主在为以色列人作战。

text_en: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
text_cn: 以后，若苏厄和所有跟随他的以色列人，回到基耳加耳营。
